name: Glass-fibre moulding
summary: Glass-fibre mat is laid in a mould and wet with resin. The resin sets and leaves a light, rust-free shell.
how: Coat the mould with wax and gel coat.
Lay mat in the mould and wet it with resin.
Let the resin set, then lift the shell and trim it.

origin.note: Owens-Corning makes glass fibre in quantity, and the first glass-fibre shells follow in the 1940s.

adoptions.via: Makers mould the sharp wedge body in glass fibre for short runs.
